name: Cinder Chimney Damper
core_rationale: Northern high-pressure smokestack ridge of The Gilded Exhaust Flues at [1, 0] where Krono's tallest fluted brass chimney vents golden thermal rings into the upper sky-lanes.

South.lock_message: Scalding golden exhaust plumes vent through the Cinder Chimney Damper; the Bellows Guild requires the Master Damper Crank from Ash-Valve Vault before opening the northern flue.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Glider-couriers say the golden smoke rings blown from Cinder Chimney float all the way up to the Shattered Halo before turning into starlight.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A colossal fluted brass smokestack crowned by spinning damper petals on the northern cliff of Bellows Hearth.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Can a glider ride the Cinder Chimney thermal plume straight into the lower rings of Continent 03?

causal_continuity.evidence: Forms the northern high-pressure exhaust vent of The Gilded Exhaust Flues above Bellows Hearth.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: A colossal fluted brass smokestack puffing rings of golden mist into the steppe sky.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: chimney catwalk and damper petal metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved at [1, 0] north of Bellows Hearth behind a fog_of_lore portal.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Maintains map_id: null, fog_of_lore portal symmetry with town-bellows-hearth, and complete mystery_hook.
